propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids (15+ in plan guide) without mechanical coupling to the criteria registry, allowing criterion text to change silently while guide claims about it become outdated
A hand-authored pin manifest for each cited criterion, regenerated only when its registry text changes, makes criterion drift visible by failing the gate with citation-mismatch diagnostics
The citation extractor depends only on closed criterion-id vocabulary matched at word boundaries, not guide markup or structure, so ordinary prose edits do not break the gate
The pin gate runs in CI by composition into existing validate-routing without a new workflow step
Criterion text changes that contradict guide claims are caught systematically across all AUTHOR_GUIDES, not just by bespoke hand-written tests for individual criteria
